title: Choplifter
build: cartridge image, CBM80 header at $8004, cold start $9593

credits.by: Dan Gorlin and Dane Bigham for Brøderbund Software, 1982

model: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code), with nine subagents on the same model

accuracy.note: nine subagents on the same model
the 43 inline words after the drawing calls described with line comments; the loader's leftovers excluded with their reasons

exclude: the end of the disk loader's copy loop at $0810, dead once it has jumped to $959C
the loader's copy of the cartridge ($8000-$80FF), left behind: the loader copies $0900-$48FF up to $8000 and nothing reads it again
the loader's copy of the cartridge ($8600-$86FD), left behind: the loader copies $0900-$48FF up to $8000 and nothing reads it again
the loader's copy of the cartridge ($B700-$BAFF), left behind: the loader copies $0900-$48FF up to $8000 and nothing reads it again
the loader's copy of the cartridge ($BF1F-$BFFF), left behind: the loader copies $0900-$48FF up to $8000 and nothing reads it again
past the 16 KB the loader copies: the program file's last five bytes, then the emulator's power-on pattern; nothing reads them
extra: pre-shifted byte tables the blitter uses instead of shifting at run time
cartridge header, shape pointer table and shape bitmaps

regions: game state, actor records, people, dirty-rectangle lists
